about: Vault cases every SDK must pass the same way (python/tests/test_vault.py and js/test/vault.test.ts; the Rust, Swift, Kotlin and Dart tests read it too; it lives under python/tests so the Python sdist carries it). Each group adds `values` in order with vault.tag(label, value) and checks the tags, then redact, hide, hide (escape), hide_value and restore. redact masks each text with the vault and spans a model found (redact_with_vault): each [value, label] of `found` is a span over the next place the value is written, in order; `want` is the text, `spans` (when given) the final spans as covered text, label and source (the Rust and Swift labels are enums, so a custom family is checked there as PERSON), and `entries` (when given) are the vault's values afterwards. hide_loose and hide_keep are for the packages with middlewares (npm, Python).
